042/**
043 * The scheduler responsible for running {@link Command}s. A Command-based robot should call {@link
044 * CommandScheduler#run()} on the singleton instance in its periodic block in order to run commands
045 * synchronously from the main loop. Subsystems should be registered with the scheduler using {@link
046 * CommandScheduler#registerSubsystem(Subsystem...)} in order for their {@link Subsystem#periodic()}
047 * methods to be called and for their default commands to be scheduled.
048 *
049 * <p>This class is provided by the Commands v2 VendorDep
050 */
051public final class CommandScheduler implements TelemetryLoggable, ComplexTunable, AutoCloseable {
052  /** The Singleton Instance. */
053  private static CommandScheduler instance;
054
055  /**
056   * Returns the Scheduler instance.
057   *
058   * @return the instance
059   */
060  public static synchronized CommandScheduler getInstance() {
061    if (instance == null) {
062      instance = new CommandScheduler();
063    }
064    return instance;
065  }
066
067  private static final Optional<Command> NO_INTERRUPTOR = Optional.empty();
068
069  private final Map<Command, Exception> m_composedCommands = new WeakHashMap<>();
070
071  // A set of the currently-running commands.
072  private final Set<Command> m_scheduledCommands = new LinkedHashSet<>();
073
074  // A map from required subsystems to their requiring commands. Also used as a set of the
075  // currently-required subsystems.
076  private final Map<Subsystem, Command> m_requirements = new LinkedHashMap<>();
077
078  // A map from subsystems registered with the scheduler to their default commands.  Also used
079  // as a list of currently-registered subsystems.
080  private final Map<Subsystem, Command> m_subsystems = new LinkedHashMap<>();
081
082  private final EventLoop m_defaultButtonLoop = new EventLoop();
083  // The set of currently-registered buttons that will be polled every iteration.
084  private EventLoop m_activeButtonLoop = m_defaultButtonLoop;
085
086  private boolean m_disabled;
087
088  // Lists of user-supplied actions to be executed on scheduling events for every command.
089  private final List<Consumer<Command>> m_initActions = new ArrayList<>();
090  private final List<Consumer<Command>> m_executeActions = new ArrayList<>();
091  private final List<BiConsumer<Command, Optional<Command>>> m_interruptActions = new ArrayList<>();
092  private final List<Consumer<Command>> m_finishActions = new ArrayList<>();
093
094  // Flag and queues for avoiding ConcurrentModificationException if commands are
095  // scheduled/canceled during run
096  private boolean m_inRunLoop;
097  private final Set<Command> m_toSchedule = new LinkedHashSet<>();
098  private final List<Command> m_toCancelCommands = new ArrayList<>();
099  private final List<Optional<Command>> m_toCancelInterruptors = new ArrayList<>();
100  private final Set<Command> m_endingCommands = new LinkedHashSet<>();
101
102  private final Watchdog m_watchdog = new Watchdog(TimedRobot.DEFAULT_PERIOD, () -> {});
103
104  CommandScheduler() {
105    UsageReporting.reportUsage("CommandScheduler", "");
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * Closes this command scheduler and releases scheduler-owned state.
110   *
111   * <p>Scheduled commands are ended as interrupted without running scheduler event hooks.
112   */
113  @Override
114  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
115  public void close() {
116    TunableRegistry.remove(this);
117    disable();
118    m_initActions.clear();
119    m_executeActions.clear();
120    m_interruptActions.clear();
121    m_finishActions.clear();
122
123    for (Command command : m_scheduledCommands.toArray(new Command[0])) {
124      if (!m_scheduledCommands.contains(command) || m_endingCommands.contains(command)) {
125        continue;
126      }
127      m_endingCommands.add(command);
128      command.end(true);
129      m_endingCommands.remove(command);
130      m_watchdog.addEpoch(command.getName() + ".end(true)");
131    }
132
133    m_watchdog.close();
134    m_scheduledCommands.clear();
135    m_requirements.clear();
136    m_subsystems.clear();
137    m_defaultButtonLoop.clear();
138    m_activeButtonLoop = m_defaultButtonLoop;
139    enable();
140    m_inRunLoop = false;
141    m_toSchedule.clear();
142    m_toCancelCommands.clear();
143    m_toCancelInterruptors.clear();
144    m_endingCommands.clear();
145    m_composedCommands.clear();
146
147    synchronized (CommandScheduler.class) {
148      if (instance == this) {
149        instance = null;
150      }
151    }
152  }

192  /**
193   * Initializes a given command, adds its requirements to the list, and performs the init actions.
194   *
195   * @param command The command to initialize
196   * @param requirements The command requirements
197   */
198  private void initCommand(Command command, Set<Subsystem> requirements) {
199    m_scheduledCommands.add(command);
200    for (Subsystem requirement : requirements) {
201      m_requirements.put(requirement, command);
202    }
203    command.initialize();
204    for (Consumer<Command> action : m_initActions) {
205      action.accept(command);
206    }
207
208    m_watchdog.addEpoch(command.getName() + ".initialize()");
209  }
210
211  /**
212   * Schedules a command for execution. Does nothing if the command is already scheduled. If a
213   * command's requirements are not available, it will only be started if all the commands currently
214   * using those requirements have been scheduled as interruptible. If this is the case, they will
215   * be interrupted and the command will be scheduled.
216   *
217   * <p>WARNING: using this function directly can often lead to unexpected behavior and should be
218   * avoided. Instead Triggers should be used to schedule Commands.
219   *
220   * @param command the command to schedule. If null, no-op.
221   */
222  private void schedule(Command command) {
223    if (command == null) {
224      DriverStationErrors.reportWarning("Tried to schedule a null command", true);
225      return;
226    }
227    if (m_inRunLoop) {
228      m_toSchedule.add(command);
229      return;
230    }
231
232    requireNotComposed(command);
233
234    // Do nothing if the scheduler is disabled, the robot is disabled and the command doesn't
235    // run when disabled, or the command is already scheduled.
236    if (m_disabled
237        || isScheduled(command)
238        || RobotState.isDisabled() && !command.runsWhenDisabled()) {
239      return;
240    }
241
242    Set<Subsystem> requirements = command.getRequirements();
243
244    // Schedule the command if the requirements are not currently in-use.
245    if (Collections.disjoint(m_requirements.keySet(), requirements)) {
246      initCommand(command, requirements);
247    } else {
248      // Else check if the requirements that are in use have all have interruptible commands,
249      // and if so, interrupt those commands and schedule the new command.
250      for (Subsystem requirement : requirements) {
251        Command requiring = requiring(requirement);
252        if (requiring != null
253            && requiring.getInterruptionBehavior() == InterruptionBehavior.CANCEL_INCOMING) {
254          return;
255        }
256      }
257      for (Subsystem requirement : requirements) {
258        Command requiring = requiring(requirement);
259        if (requiring != null) {
260          cancel(requiring, Optional.of(command));
261        }
262      }
263      initCommand(command, requirements);
264    }
265  }
266
267  /**
268   * Schedules multiple commands for execution. Does nothing for commands already scheduled.
269   *
270   * <p>WARNING: using this function directly can often lead to unexpected behavior and should be
271   * avoided. Instead Triggers should be used to schedule Commands.
272   *
273   * @param commands the commands to schedule. No-op on null.
274   */
275  public void schedule(Command... commands) {
276    for (Command command : commands) {
277      schedule(command);
278    }
279  }
280
281  /**
282   * Runs a single iteration of the scheduler. The execution occurs in the following order:
283   *
284   * <p>Subsystem periodic methods are called.
285   *
286   * <p>Button bindings are polled, and new commands are scheduled from them.
287   *
288   * <p>Currently-scheduled commands are executed.
289   *
290   * <p>End conditions are checked on currently-scheduled commands, and commands that are finished
291   * have their end methods called and are removed.
292   *
293   * <p>Any subsystems not being used as requirements have their default methods started.
294   */
295  public void run() {
296    if (m_disabled) {
297      return;
298    }
299    m_watchdog.reset();
300
301    // Run the periodic method of all registered subsystems.
302    for (Subsystem subsystem : m_subsystems.keySet()) {
303      subsystem.periodic();
304      if (RobotBase.isSimulation()) {
305        subsystem.simulationPeriodic();
306      }
307      m_watchdog.addEpoch(subsystem.getName() + ".periodic()");
308    }
309
310    // Cache the active instance to avoid concurrency problems if setActiveLoop() is called from
311    // inside the button bindings.
312    EventLoop loopCache = m_activeButtonLoop;
313    // Poll buttons for new commands to add.
314    loopCache.poll();
315    m_watchdog.addEpoch("buttons.run()");
316
317    m_inRunLoop = true;
318    boolean isDisabled = RobotState.isDisabled();
319    // Run scheduled commands, remove finished commands.
320    for (Iterator<Command> iterator = m_scheduledCommands.iterator(); iterator.hasNext(); ) {
321      Command command = iterator.next();
322
323      if (isDisabled && !command.runsWhenDisabled()) {
324        cancel(command, NO_INTERRUPTOR);
325        continue;
326      }
327
328      command.execute();
329      for (Consumer<Command> action : m_executeActions) {
330        action.accept(command);
331      }
332      m_watchdog.addEpoch(command.getName() + ".execute()");
333      if (command.isFinished()) {
334        m_endingCommands.add(command);
335        command.end(false);
336        for (Consumer<Command> action : m_finishActions) {
337          action.accept(command);
338        }
339        m_endingCommands.remove(command);
340        iterator.remove();
341
342        m_requirements.keySet().removeAll(command.getRequirements());
343        m_watchdog.addEpoch(command.getName() + ".end(false)");
344      }
345    }
346    m_inRunLoop = false;
347
348    // Schedule/cancel commands from queues populated during loop
349    for (Command command : m_toSchedule) {
350      schedule(command);
351    }
352
353    for (int i = 0; i < m_toCancelCommands.size(); i++) {
354      cancel(m_toCancelCommands.get(i), m_toCancelInterruptors.get(i));
355    }
356
357    m_toSchedule.clear();
358    m_toCancelCommands.clear();
359    m_toCancelInterruptors.clear();
360
361    // Add default commands for un-required registered subsystems.
362    for (Map.Entry<Subsystem, Command> subsystemCommand : m_subsystems.entrySet()) {
363      if (!m_requirements.containsKey(subsystemCommand.getKey())
364          && subsystemCommand.getValue() != null) {
365        schedule(subsystemCommand.getValue());
366      }
367    }
368
369    m_watchdog.disable();
370    if (m_watchdog.isExpired()) {
371      System.out.println("CommandScheduler loop overrun");
372      m_watchdog.printEpochs();
373    }
374  }

376  /**
377   * Registers subsystems with the scheduler. This must be called for the subsystem's periodic block
378   * to run when the scheduler is run, and for the subsystem's default command to be scheduled. It
379   * is recommended to call this from the constructor of your subsystem implementations.
380   *
381   * @param subsystems the subsystem to register
382   */
383  public void registerSubsystem(Subsystem... subsystems) {
384    for (Subsystem subsystem : subsystems) {
385      if (subsystem == null) {
386        DriverStationErrors.reportWarning("Tried to register a null subsystem", true);
387        continue;
388      }
389      if (m_subsystems.containsKey(subsystem)) {
390        DriverStationErrors.reportWarning(
391            "Tried to register an already-registered subsystem", true);
392        continue;
393      }
394      m_subsystems.put(subsystem, null);
395    }
396  }
397
398  /**
399   * Un-registers subsystems with the scheduler. The subsystem will no longer have its periodic
400   * block called, and will not have its default command scheduled.
401   *
402   * @param subsystems the subsystem to un-register
403   */
404  public void unregisterSubsystem(Subsystem... subsystems) {
405    m_subsystems.keySet().removeAll(Set.of(subsystems));
406  }

408  /**
409   * Un-registers all registered Subsystems with the scheduler. All currently registered subsystems
410   * will no longer have their periodic block called, and will not have their default command
411   * scheduled.
412   */
413  public void unregisterAllSubsystems() {
414    m_subsystems.clear();
415  }

417  /**
418   * Sets the default command for a subsystem. Registers that subsystem if it is not already
419   * registered. Default commands will run whenever there is no other command currently scheduled
420   * that requires the subsystem. Default commands should be written to never end (i.e. their {@link
421   * Command#isFinished()} method should return false), as they would simply be re-scheduled if they
422   * do. Default commands must also require their subsystem.
423   *
424   * @param subsystem the subsystem whose default command will be set
425   * @param defaultCommand the default command to associate with the subsystem
426   */
427  public void setDefaultCommand(Subsystem subsystem, Command defaultCommand) {
428    if (subsystem == null) {
429      DriverStationErrors.reportWarning(
430          "Tried to set a default command for a null subsystem", true);
431      return;
432    }
433    if (defaultCommand == null) {
434      DriverStationErrors.reportWarning("Tried to set a null default command", true);
435      return;
436    }
437
438    requireNotComposed(defaultCommand);
439
440    if (!defaultCommand.getRequirements().contains(subsystem)) {
441      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Default commands must require their subsystem!");
442    }
443
444    if (defaultCommand.getInterruptionBehavior() == InterruptionBehavior.CANCEL_INCOMING) {
445      DriverStationErrors.reportWarning(
446          "Registering a non-interruptible default command!\n"
447              + "This will likely prevent any other commands from requiring this subsystem.",
448          true);
449      // Warn, but allow -- there might be a use case for this.
450    }
451
452    m_subsystems.put(subsystem, defaultCommand);
453  }
454
455  /**
456   * Removes the default command for a subsystem. The current default command will run until another
457   * command is scheduled that requires the subsystem, at which point the current default command
458   * will not be re-scheduled.
459   *
460   * @param subsystem the subsystem whose default command will be removed
461   */
462  public void removeDefaultCommand(Subsystem subsystem) {
463    if (subsystem == null) {
464      DriverStationErrors.reportWarning(
465          "Tried to remove a default command for a null subsystem", true);
466      return;
467    }
468
469    m_subsystems.put(subsystem, null);
470  }

483  /**
484   * Cancels commands. The scheduler will only call {@link Command#end(boolean)} method of the
485   * canceled command with {@code true}, indicating they were canceled (as opposed to finishing
486   * normally).
487   *
488   * <p>Commands will be canceled regardless of {@link InterruptionBehavior interruption behavior}.
489   *
490   * @param commands the commands to cancel
491   */
492  public void cancel(Command... commands) {
493    for (Command command : commands) {
494      cancel(command, NO_INTERRUPTOR);
495    }
496  }
497
498  /**
499   * Cancels a command. The scheduler will only call {@link Command#end(boolean)} method of the
500   * canceled command with {@code true}, indicating they were canceled (as opposed to finishing
501   * normally).
502   *
503   * <p>Commands will be canceled regardless of {@link InterruptionBehavior interruption behavior}.
504   *
505   * @param command the command to cancel
506   * @param interruptor the interrupting command, if any
507   */
508  private void cancel(Command command, Optional<Command> interruptor) {
509    if (command == null) {
510      DriverStationErrors.reportWarning("Tried to cancel a null command", true);
511      return;
512    }
513    if (m_endingCommands.contains(command)) {
514      return;
515    }
516    if (m_inRunLoop) {
517      m_toCancelCommands.add(command);
518      m_toCancelInterruptors.add(interruptor);
519      return;
520    }
521    if (!isScheduled(command)) {
522      return;
523    }
524
525    m_endingCommands.add(command);
526    command.end(true);
527    for (BiConsumer<Command, Optional<Command>> action : m_interruptActions) {
528      action.accept(command, interruptor);
529    }
530    m_endingCommands.remove(command);
531    m_scheduledCommands.remove(command);
532    m_requirements.keySet().removeAll(command.getRequirements());
533    m_watchdog.addEpoch(command.getName() + ".end(true)");
534  }
535
536  /** Cancels all commands that are currently scheduled. */
537  public void cancelAll() {
538    // Copy to array to avoid concurrent modification.
539    cancel(m_scheduledCommands.toArray(new Command[0]));
540  }

542  /**
543   * Whether the given commands are running. Note that this only works on commands that are directly
544   * scheduled by the scheduler; it will not work on commands inside compositions, as the scheduler
545   * does not see them.
546   *
547   * @param commands multiple commands to check
548   * @return whether all of the commands are currently scheduled
549   */
550  public boolean isScheduled(Command... commands) {
551    for (var cmd : commands) {
552      if (!isScheduled(cmd)) {
553        return false;
554      }
555    }
556    return true;
557  }
558
559  /**
560   * Whether the given commands are running. Note that this only works on commands that are directly
561   * scheduled by the scheduler; it will not work on commands inside compositions, as the scheduler
562   * does not see them.
563   *
564   * @param command a single command to check
565   * @return whether all of the commands are currently scheduled
566   */
567  public boolean isScheduled(Command command) {
568    return m_scheduledCommands.contains(command);
569  }

647  /**
648   * Register commands as composed. An exception will be thrown if these commands are scheduled
649   * directly or added to a composition.
650   *
651   * @param commands the commands to register
652   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the given commands have already been composed, or the array
653   *     of commands has duplicates.
654   */
655  public void registerComposedCommands(Command... commands) {
656    Set<Command> commandSet;
657    try {
658      commandSet = Set.of(commands);
659    } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
660      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
661          "Cannot compose a command twice in the same composition! (Original exception: "
662              + e
663              + ")");
664    }
665    requireNotComposedOrScheduled(commandSet);
666    var exception = new Exception("Originally composed at:");
667    exception.fillInStackTrace();
668    for (var command : commands) {
669      m_composedCommands.put(command, exception);
670    }
671  }

696  /**
697   * Strip additional leading stack trace elements that are in the framework package.
698   *
699   * @param stacktrace the original stacktrace
700   * @return the stacktrace stripped of leading elements so there is at max one leading element from
701   *     the org.wpilib.command2 package.
702   */
703  private StackTraceElement[] stripFrameworkStackElements(StackTraceElement[] stacktrace) {
704    int i = stacktrace.length - 1;
705    for (; i > 0; i--) {
706      if (stacktrace[i].getClassName().startsWith("org.wpilib.command2.")) {
707        break;
708      }
709    }
710    return Arrays.copyOfRange(stacktrace, i, stacktrace.length);
711  }
712
713  /**
714   * Requires that the specified command hasn't already been added to a composition.
715   *
716   * @param commands The commands to check
717   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the given commands have already been composed.
718   */
719  public void requireNotComposed(Command... commands) {
720    for (var command : commands) {
721      var exception = m_composedCommands.getOrDefault(command, null);
722      if (exception != null) {
723        exception.setStackTrace(stripFrameworkStackElements(exception.getStackTrace()));
724        var buffer = new StringWriter();
725        var writer = new PrintWriter(buffer);
726        writer.println(
727            "Commands that have been composed may not be added to another composition or scheduled "
728                + "individually!");
729        exception.printStackTrace(writer);
730        var thrownException = new IllegalArgumentException(buffer.toString());
731        thrownException.setStackTrace(stripFrameworkStackElements(thrownException.getStackTrace()));
732        throw thrownException;
733      }
734    }
735  }
736
737  /**
738   * Requires that the specified commands have not already been added to a composition.
739   *
740   * @param commands The commands to check
741   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the given commands have already been composed.
742   */
743  public void requireNotComposed(Collection<Command> commands) {
744    requireNotComposed(commands.toArray(Command[]::new));
745  }
746
747  /**
748   * Requires that the specified command hasn't already been added to a composition, and is not
749   * currently scheduled.
750   *
751   * @param command The command to check
752   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the given command has already been composed or scheduled.
753   */
754  public void requireNotComposedOrScheduled(Command command) {
755    if (isScheduled(command)) {
756      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
757          "Commands that have been scheduled individually may not be added to a composition!");
758    }
759    requireNotComposed(command);
760  }
761
762  /**
763   * Requires that the specified commands have not already been added to a composition, and are not
764   * currently scheduled.
765   *
766   * @param commands The commands to check
767   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the given commands have already been composed or scheduled.
768   */
769  public void requireNotComposedOrScheduled(Collection<Command> commands) {
770    for (var command : commands) {
771      requireNotComposedOrScheduled(command);
772    }
773  }
774
775  /**
776   * Check if the given command has been composed.
777   *
778   * @param command The command to check
779   * @return true if composed
780   */
781  public boolean isComposed(Command command) {
782    return getComposedCommands().contains(command);
783  }
784
785  Set<Command> getComposedCommands() {
786    return m_composedCommands.keySet();
787  }
788
789  private String[] getScheduledCommandNames() {
790    String[] names = new String[m_scheduledCommands.size()];
791    int i = 0;
792    for (Command command : m_scheduledCommands) {
793      names[i] = command.getName();
794      i++;
795    }
796    return names;
797  }
798
799  private long[] getScheduledCommandIds() {
800    long[] ids = new long[m_scheduledCommands.size()];
801    int i = 0;
802    for (Command command : m_scheduledCommands) {
803      ids[i] = command.hashCode();
804      i++;
805    }
806    return ids;
807  }
808
809  @Override
810  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
811    String[] names = getScheduledCommandNames();
812    table.log("Names", names);
813
814    long[] ids = getScheduledCommandIds();
815    table.log("Ids", ids);
816  }
817
818  @Override
819  public String getTelemetryType() {
820    return "Scheduler";
821  }
822
823  @Override
824  public void publishTunable(TunableTable table) {
825    TunableConfig immutableConfig =
826        TunableConfig.of(TunableOption.IMMUTABLE, TunableOption.ALWAYS_GET);
827    table.publish(
828        "Names",
829        Tunable.createConfig(
830            this::getScheduledCommandNames, null, String[].class, immutableConfig));
831    table.publish(
832        "Ids",
833        Tunable.createConfig(this::getScheduledCommandIds, null, long[].class, immutableConfig));
834
835    final long[] empty = {};
836    table.publish(
837        "Cancel",
838        Tunable.createConfig(
839            () -> empty,
840            toCancel -> {
841              Map<Long, Command> ids = new LinkedHashMap<>();
842              for (Command command : m_scheduledCommands) {
843                long id = command.hashCode();
844                ids.put(id, command);
845              }
846              for (long hash : toCancel) {
847                cancel(ids.get(hash));
848              }
849            },
850            long[].class,
851            TunableConfig.of(TunableOption.ROBUST, TunableOption.ALWAYS_GET)));
852  }
853
854  @Override
855  public String getTunableType() {
856    return "Scheduler";
857  }
